name: @two_5_d/core-editor-pack
description: The Cardboard editor itself, shipped as an editor pack. After CORE_EDITOR_PACK.md ships, apps/editor/ is a bare shell + primitives and every view/panel/layout lives here. P1 of that plan is the de-risking spike: validate the pack-builder can externalize React + the shell SDK so pack-shipped TSX components share React with the host. The skeleton is intentionally empty for P1 — only a trivial spike script that uses React.useState to prove externalization works.
